gaps.sentence: Your name ___ (find) anywhere on the guest list, I'm afraid.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive of ability/possibility: cannot be + past participle.

gaps.sentence: She's having her wedding dress ___ by a tailor in Naples.
gaps.explanation: Have + object + past participle: having her dress made by a professional.

gaps.sentence: By the time the reporters arrived, the evidence ___ (destroy).
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: had been + past participle for the action completed before the arrival.

gaps.sentence: The experiments ___ (conduct) under strict laboratory conditions last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Last year' fixes past simple passive: were + conducted for the plural subject.

gaps.sentence: By this time tomorrow, the results ___ to every candidate.
gaps.explanation: 'By this time tomorrow' requires future perfect passive: will have been + emailed.

gaps.sentence: I don't like ___ how to run my own department.
gaps.explanation: The speaker receives the telling: passive gerund being + told.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't use the meeting room because it ___ (clean) all morning.
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was being + cleaned over a period in the past.

gaps.sentence: The national anthem ___ (compose) by a little-known music teacher.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: was + composed; 'by a music teacher' names the agent.
